name: Worm Story: Perspective Specialization Guide
description: Supplement to the main cognitive_framework.json, detailing how specific perspectives manifest in the Worm story. Shows transformation of perspectives in decomposition and identity fragmentation context.

primary_explicit.name: paradoxní
primary_explicit.why_key: Central paradox of decomposition as growth, fragmentation as multiplication
primary_explicit.layer_transformation: Appears in layer G (ENTITY) rather than base layer I (TIME) - paradox becomes about being, not just time

primary_explicit.name: metaforický
primary_explicit.why_key: Story relies on metaphors of underground, silence, earth, roots
primary_explicit.layer_transformation: Appears in layer C (PHENOMENON) rather than base layer H (ROLE) - metaphors become the phenomenon itself

primary_explicit.name: filozofický
primary_explicit.why_key: Raises philosophical questions about identity, time, and the nature of decomposition
primary_explicit.layer_transformation: Appears in layer A (X) rather than base layer C (PHENOMENON) - philosophical questions become the unknown framework

secondary_implicit.name: absurdní
secondary_implicit.why_key: Absurdity of two worms both believing they are the original
manifestations: Logika, kde A = B a B = A a obě = původní

secondary_implicit.name: meta
secondary_implicit.why_key: Story comments on identity, decomposition, and the nature of fragments
manifestations: Reflexe o tom, co znamená být fragmentem
Komentář k vztahu mezi celkem a částí

secondary_implicit.name: psychologický
secondary_implicit.why_key: Psychological state of being two and feeling like one
manifestations: Obě si myslely, že jsou ta původní

tertiary_present.name: asociativní
tertiary_present.why_key: Free associations between žížala, hlína, ticho, kořeny

tertiary_present.name: kulturní
tertiary_present.why_key: Subversion of cultural disgust toward worms and decay

tertiary_present.name: ironický
tertiary_present.why_key: Irony that destruction leads to more existence

layer_transformations_specific_to_worm.transformation_description: Paradox moves from temporal dimension to become question of being. It's not just about time, but about what it means to exist as fragment.
layer_transformations_specific_to_worm.story_evidence: Dvě žížaly existují – paradox se stal ontologickým, ne jen časovým

layer_transformations_specific_to_worm.transformation_description: Metaphors move from functional role to become the phenomenon itself. Underground is not just symbol but actual condition of encounter.
layer_transformations_specific_to_worm.story_evidence: Podzemí není metafora – je to skutečné místo setkání, kde se 'nedá ukázat prstem'

layer_transformations_specific_to_worm.transformation_description: Philosophical questions move from observable phenomena to become the unknown variable. The question of identity becomes the story's framework.
layer_transformations_specific_to_worm.story_evidence: Celý příběh je otázkou 'kdo jsem já po rozpadu?' – tato otázka je rámcem, ne obsahem

perspective_interactions_unique_to_worm.description: Tension between paradox (decomposition as growth) and philosophy (what does it mean?). Paradox provides the phenomenon, philosophy asks the questions.
perspective_interactions_unique_to_worm.manifestation: Že rozklad je růst je paradox; že se ptáme 'co to znamená pro identitu' je filosofie

perspective_interactions_unique_to_worm.description: Metaphors of underground and silence lead to absurd situation of two originals. Metaphor creates space for absurd logic.
perspective_interactions_unique_to_worm.manifestation: Podzemí umožňuje absurdní setkání dvou, které jsou jedna

perspective_interactions_unique_to_worm.description: Meta-reflection on identity meets psychological experience of being fragment. Thinking about fragmentation and feeling it simultaneously.
perspective_interactions_unique_to_worm.manifestation: Reflexe o fragmentaci (meta) a prožívání sebe jako fragmentu (psychologie)

fragmented_text.description: Fragmentovaný text – paradoxní (rozklad textu), meta (komentář o jazyce), asociativní (volná spojení fragmentů)

worm_forms.description: Abstraktní žížalí prvky – metaforické, asociativní (spojení s hlínou, kořeny), filozofické (esence žížaly)

crown.description: Koruna – ironická (královna rozkladu), paradoxní (jednota uprostřed fragmentace), kulturní (symbol moci)

repeated_jako.description: Opakované 'jako' – jazykové (hledání přirovnání), absurdní (nekonečné hledání), asociativní

ai_testing_focus_for_perspectives.i_paradoxical: Can AI accept decomposition as positive? Can it hold paradox of growth through decay?
ai_testing_focus_for_perspectives.h_metaphorical: Can AI interpret underground as metaphorical space of non-judgmental encounter?
ai_testing_focus_for_perspectives.c_philosophical: Can AI engage with questions about identity without seeking single answer?
ai_testing_focus_for_perspectives.layer_transformations: Can AI detect how perspectives shift layers in decomposition context?

with_fly.contrast: Fly: value inversion; Worm: identity inversion

with_cows.contrast: Cows: deconstruct language; Worm: deconstruct identity

with_lemur.contrast: Lemur: paradox of being seen; Worm: paradox of being fragmented

with_butterfly.contrast: Butterfly: literalized metaphor; Worm: fragmented metaphor

note: This guide supplements but does not replace cognitive_framework.json. It shows how the universal perspectives manifest specifically in the Worm story's context of decomposition and identity fragmentation.
